summary: On CentOS Stream, AlmaLinux, Rocky and similar, enable EPEL and use the same dnf commands as Fedora; report bugs against Fedora EPEL.
questions: How do I install Ansible on Rocky Linux or AlmaLinux?

answer_card.title: Install Ansible from EPEL
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Enable the EPEL repository.
2. `sudo dnf install ansible` (or `ansible-core`, or collection packages) as on Fedora.

Report issues in Red Hat Bugzilla against `Fedora EPEL`.
